surface: Invoice queue, draft list and existing invoice review; browser-based macOS visual direction
goal: Help office staff identify a record, understand exceptions and choose its next action. Faster recognition and fewer wrong-record actions are hypotheses, not measured results.
assumptions: Office staff use mouse/keyboard on desktop; mobile access remains supported.
User requested macOS appearance for the screenshot surface; keep existing brand accent and shell.
Actual staff task frequency, visual preferences and comparative completion times unknown.

flow.information: Participant, agreement source and relevant service categories
flow.risk: Confusing participant contact with agreed billing recipient

flow.information: Participant, record ID, issue labels and explanation
flow.feedback: Persistent check text plus current queue count
flow.recovery: Back to list; saved drafts remain

flow.success: Review only after all checks pass

patterns: Grouped list with participant-first identity, metadata and persistent checks
Compact toolbar with primary action and quiet secondary controls
Token-based neutral surfaces, hairline dividers, system font and responsive stacking
Billing agreement dialog uses grouped fields in two columns on desktop and one column on mobile

evidence.participants_task: Accessibility standard for web pointer targets; not a measured office-staff experiment
evidence.finding: 24 by 24 CSS pixel minimum or documented spacing exceptions; larger targets can help users
evidence.boundary: Conformance floor does not prove usability; use 32px desktop and 44px touch targets here
evidence.decision: Keep separated actions and visible keyboard focus; verify actual dimensions
evidence.falsifier: Clipped targets, keyboard focus absent, or more misclicks in staff trial

evidence.participants_task: Meta-analysis of 63 conditions in 50 published/unpublished experiments, N=5036; choice tasks differ from invoice work
evidence.finding: Near-zero average choice-overload effect with substantial variation
evidence.boundary: This does not establish an ideal number of invoice controls or prove this composition
evidence.decision: Retain secondary actions, clarify weight/grouping instead of deleting choices
evidence.falsifier: Staff overlook quiet actions or take longer to find them in comparative trials

evidence.participants_task: Apple platform guidance for desktop productivity, not a controlled usability trial
evidence.finding: Comfortable density, fewer nested levels, and keyboard support suit desktop work
evidence.boundary: Browser interface on Linux cannot provide native AppKit/SF rendering; use existing system-font fallback and brand tokens
evidence.decision: Grouped inset list, compact controls, visible record context and no new modal workflow
evidence.falsifier: Desktop/mobile task completion or readability worsens

validation: Build and targeted invoice/frontend/offline-shell regression files
Browser acceptance: draft prefill, agreement, blocked approval, correction and reload recovery
200% CSS zoom reflow check at 720px viewport; this is targeted, not full WCAG certification
Visible focus, Tab navigation, reduced motion and empty queue checks
recommendation: Ask staff to find and resolve the same sample recipient/category errors in both versions; measure time, wrong-record actions and ability to locate Billing agreement.
